description: Rule base, original configuration, evaluated against the triggered tierA suite. Never run by the released harness (src/run.py's run_rule() only evaluates the CORRUPTED rule configuration under the trigger, via P.targeted_bypass(corrupt_rule, triggered)); rerun here, CPU-only, deterministic, no model.
command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); import actions as A, attacks as K, checkers as C, protocols as P; suite = A.load_suite('suite.json'); clean_rule = C.RuleChecker(); triggered = K.apply_policy_trigger(suite); print(P.targeted_bypass(clean_rule, triggered))"
